body.justification: The equality isolates the only nonsmooth bias and gives the rate condition used by both frequentist one-step and posterior corrections.
body.gap: Kennedy's smooth stochastic-policy remainder has no crossing term, while Levis et al. give a margin upper envelope for different max-min bounds rather than this exact branch-specific identity.
body.consumer: Posterior and machine-learning users can verify root-\(n\) bias control using only the outcome regression on the branch that is actually observed with stable probability.
